blade.name: Eclipse Blade
blade.lede: Set it down behind the ball and it just looks right. It's fully milled from 431 stainless, so the strike feels solid and muted, with no ring and no buzz, and you'll know exactly where you caught it. It stays planted all the way through the stroke, and it's gold from heel to toe.
gallery: The Eclipse Blade in hand on the green
A putt dropping, shot from the cup
details: Fully CNC-milled 431 stainless steel, 3.5° of loft at 35 inches, finished in gold.
One putter on our stock shaft and stock grip. No headcover, so the Blade Cover is the one to grab.

Orders leave Long Beach, California in 1 to 2 business days, and the tracking number shows up as soon as the carrier scans it. Every club gets sixty days from delivery. Talk to us before anything ships back, because club returns need our OK and a few photos first. Return shipping's on you.

story.head: The putter that tells you the truth
body: Fully milled with no insert, so what you feel at impact is the metal itself. Middle one and it's soft and solid. Miss the middle and you'll feel exactly where, which is how a stroke gets better.

film: 16:9, 40 to 60 seconds. The head milled, then three putts rolled: a short one, a breaker, a long lag. Sound on for the strike.
blade.specline: All of it comes straight from the manufacturer. One loft, one length and a gold finish.
blade.specnote: Same loft and length as the Mallet. The difference is the head shape and how it feels on the putts you miss.
quotes: The look alone is amazing!!! And I haven't putted this good in my life. I should have switched to blades years ago
I bought it because it's so pretty but it's a real step up from my old putter.
The quality and look on this putter is amzing . Everytime i play someone will ask where i bought it .

mallet.name: Eclipse Mallet
mallet.lede: Line it up and let it go. It's fully milled from 304 stainless, and the mallet head spreads its weight out, so a putt you don't middle still holds its line. Soft and muted at impact, gold all over, and easy to look down at when the putt actually matters.
gallery: The Eclipse Mallet on the green
The Mallet and two Lucky hats
details: Fully CNC-milled 304 stainless steel, 3.5° of loft at 35 inches, finished in gold.
One putter on our stock shaft and stock grip. No headcover, so the Mallet Cover is the one to grab.

Orders leave Long Beach, California in 1 to 2 business days, and the tracking number shows up as soon as the carrier scans it. Every club gets sixty days from delivery. Talk to us before anything ships back, because club returns need our OK and a few photos first. Return shipping's on you.

story.head: Miss the middle. Make it anyway.
body: The mallet shape pushes weight out toward the edges of the head, so a strike off the toe or heel stays on line instead of leaking away. Same fully milled build as the Blade, with more head behind the ball.

film: 16:9, 40 to 60 seconds. Head from above, alignment at address, then three putts: centre, toe, heel, all holding the line.
mallet.specline: All of it comes straight from the manufacturer. One loft, one length and a gold finish.
mallet.specnote: Same loft and length as the Blade. What changes is where the weight sits, and what that does to a putt you don't middle.

Perfect putter, craftsmanship is second to none, Specs are perfect.  Love my putter!
Bought my boyfriend the limited edition mallet putter for graduation and he loved it! The gold has a very striking look that catches the eye.

stryker.name: Stryker
stryker.lede: Your 4-iron's retirement plan. The Stryker is a titanium hybrid that launches high and easy from the fairway, the rough and anywhere else you end up. The Flex Channel face keeps the ball flying on the strikes you don't catch pure, and the Glide Sole cuts through the rough like it isn't there. Long approaches just got a lot less scary.
details: Titanium head with a Flex Channel face and a Glide Sole, 19° at 40.5 inches, on a stiff flex shaft. Brushed satin gold face, mirror gold sole, and a gloss black crown with a gold starburst.
One hybrid on the stiff flex shaft and our stock grip. No headcover in the box.

Orders leave Long Beach, California in 1 to 2 business days, and the tracking number shows up as soon as the carrier scans it. Every club gets sixty days from delivery. Talk to us before anything ships back, because club returns need our OK and a few photos first. Return shipping's on you.

story.head: Hit it from anywhere.
body: Nineteen degrees covers the number that's too long for your irons and too short for a wood. The titanium head and Flex Channel face keep the ball speed up when the strike's a little low, so the long approach stops being a guess.

film: 16:9, 40 to 60 seconds. Address view, face detail, then three shots: off the deck, out of the rough, and off a tee on a long par three.
stryker.specline: All of it comes straight from the manufacturer. One loft, one length and a stiff shaft.
stryker.specnote: Nineteen degrees sits where a 3-iron or a 5-wood would.
specs: Brushed satin gold face, mirror gold sole, gloss black crown with a gold starburst
quotes: Played 2 rounds and love swinging and hitting a fairway shot. Best club in my bag now
I'm loving my new hybrid. The gold color is stunning and the performance is unmatched. This club has replaced my sorry 3 wood.
I really like this hybrid. I'm still getting used to hitting it but I played it last night and what a beautiful sound it made when I struck it right!
